subject: english
stem: What happens next in this passage after “Visitors walked around the classroom and read the labels.”?
options: They learned not only about objects, but also about families.
It is also about taking responsibility for what humans leave behind.
It is also a place where families built lives.
The students also asked shop owners about business.

optionRationales.reason: 本文可直接核對「Visitors walked around the classroom and read the labels. They learned not only about objects, but also about families.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「It is also about taking responsibility for what humans leave behind.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「It is also a place where families built lives.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「The students also asked shop owners about business.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「Visitors walked around the classroom and read the labels. They learned not only about objects, but also about families.」，答案為「They learned not only about objects, but also about families.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「They learned not only about objects, but also about families.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
